identity.title: Gitleaks Default-Rule Restoration
identity.objective: Restore real gitleaks detection: extend the embedded default rule set through the official [extend] useDefault = true mechanism, replace the whole-file deferred-log path exclusion with only the exact WP14-D002 line regex, list each manually classified historical fixture finding by exact fingerprint in .gitleaksignore, prove detection with a deterministic regression and negative matrix, and let the deterministic spec guard govern exactly the two repository-root secret-scan configuration paths as local offline tooling.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CI-SEC-02. .gitleaks.toml returns to the WP15 allowlist-only shape (zero rules, scans pass vacuously), .gitleaksignore is removed and the spec guard again rejects the two root secret-scan paths. No product source, workflow, dependency, credential, runtime, execution, live, capital or persistent state is changed or migrated.
